freeze_rationale: the -v6 lane is accepted and its control executed the declared transition to Runtime Baseline v6; #644 declared a transition to Runtime Baseline v7 (the eight protected blobs reports/runtime/baseline-v7-declaration.json declares (evidence sufficiency, the governed transition witness, the recall observation receipt, the runtime adapter and recall control); ranking policy 3.4.0, assertion filter 6.1.0 and public contract 1.6.0 are unchanged), so the executing runtime is new and needs a new lane id (change_rule; docs/67: a successor needs new lane ids)

the control runs the shipped default (recall_control off, semantic route off, no typed proposition, proposition extractor off) at the case budget through bridge 0.4.0 with AGENT_MEMORY_AMB_CROSS_FACT_SIDECAR set; per case, against the accepted -v6 control (#770): correct, context, meta.relevant_beliefs, meta.pinned_beliefs, meta.retrieved_questions, meta.retrieval_precision, meta.retrieval_recall, meta.pinned_coverage, meta.resolution, meta.failures and meta.retrieved_count, compared by query_id, must equal -v6, and each cross-fact.jsonl record must equal -v6 in limited_count, limited_document_ids and refusal_counts, with -v6's 0 limited carried over; the four blank-query cases run no recall, carry no record and must equal -v6; the rule is equality, not attribution, and any difference blocks v7 publication; scripts/check_cross_fact_attribution.py is reused unchanged with --v4-dir the -v6 lane evidence and --v6-dir this lane's, and the acceptance test additionally requires verdict_counts {EQUAL: 77} and per-record cross-fact equality

expected effect, recorded before any score under this lane: the declared v7 changes alter no ranking policy, assertion filter or public contract version, so v7 is expected to be observationally identical to v6 and no case is expected to differ; up/down counts and the summary deltas are reported, never gated, and must be zero; disclosure: non-importable local reproductions of this exact configuration at the v7 candidate b854d5e (#644 independent validation) were visible before this freeze; no frozen fact differs from -v6, so they could not shape any frozen choice, and they are not lane evidence
the agent-memory-shadow row stays deferred (#770): unchanged from -v6, where its reason is recorded; it is neither re-executed nor copied forward
the agent_memory_semantic row stays deferred for the uv.lock conflict (plan-669-lanes-v3 D3, unchanged at -v6 and -v7)

the BM25 baseline is re-executed and must equal -v6 exactly; the Mem0 row is re-executed, a difference from -v6 being an environment finding as at -v4 to -v6; accepted -v6 rows are never copied forward, and no -v7 row is accepted before its workflow-imported evidence is independently reviewed
